units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 4) culpable acts by a civil servant directly handling monetary or commodity valuables, if those acts give the employer's representative grounds for losing confidence in the civil servant;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 5) adoption by a civil servant holding a civil service position in the ‘managers’ category of an unfounded decision that resulted in failure to safeguard property, its unlawful use or other damage to the property of the state body;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 6) a single gross breach of official duties by a civil servant holding a civil service position in the ‘managers’ category, resulting in harm to the state body and (or) a breach of the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 7) submission by a civil servant, upon entry into civil service and (or) during service, of forged documents and (or) knowingly false information confirming compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements whose breach precludes holding a civil service position, or failure by the civil servant to submit documents and (or) information indicating non-compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements whose breach precludes holding a civil service position;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 8) termination of a civil servant's clearance for information constituting a state secret, or refusal to grant such clearance to a civil servant, if the performance of official duties requires access to such information;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 8.1) absence from service for more than four consecutive months due to temporary incapacity for work, unless the legislation of the Russian Federation establishes a longer period for retaining the job (position) in the case of a particular illness or provides guarantees for retaining the job (position) for a particular category of citizens;
units.label: Point 8.1 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 8.2) reduction of civil service positions in a state body;
units.label: Point 8.2 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 8.3) abolition of a state body;
units.label: Point 8.3 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 8.4) failure by a civil servant to return to service upon the expiry of three months after completing military service upon mobilization, service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation upon mobilization, or military service under a contract concluded during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or after the expiry of a contract concluded by the civil servant for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, taking into account extension of that period by the period of the civil servant's temporary incapacity for work;
units.label: Point 8.4 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 9) in other cases provided for by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 2. Dismissal from civil service on the grounds provided for in points 1 and 8 of part 1 of this Article is permitted if it is impossible to transfer the civil servant, with their consent, to another civil service position.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 2.1. Dismissal from civil service on the ground provided for in point 8 of part 1 of this Article is permitted if it is impossible to transfer the civil servant, with their consent, to another civil service position in the same state body in the case provided for in point 5 of part 5 of Article 28 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 3. A civil servant may not be released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service at the initiative of the employer's representative while on leave, during absence from service due to temporary incapacity for work for less than the periods specified in point 8.1 of part 1 of this Article, or during temporary incapacity for work due to injury, occupational disease or other damage to health connected with the performance of official duties, irrespective of the duration of that period.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 3.1. If a service contract is terminated on the grounds provided for in points 8.1–8.3 of part 1 of this Article, the civil servant shall be paid compensation equal to four months' monetary remuneration. No severance allowance shall be paid in that case.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 3.2. A civil servant dismissed from a state body located in the Far North or equivalent localities on the grounds provided for in points 8.2 and 8.3 of part 1 of this Article shall, in addition to the compensation specified in part 3.1 of this Article, be paid compensation for the fifth and sixth months from the date of dismissal by decision of the employment service body, provided that the civil servant applied to that body within one month after dismissal and was not placed in employment by it. That compensation shall be paid by the employer's representative of the state body in which the civil servant held a civil service position, from the funds of that state body.
units.label: Part 3.2 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Termination of a service contract on the employer's representative's initiative
units.text: 4. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 87-ФЗ of 22.04.2024.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 37

units.locator: Article 38. Informing the elected trade union body when terminating a service contract
units.text: Article 38. Informing the elected trade union body when terminating a service contract
units.label: Art. 38

units.locator: Article 38. Informing the elected trade union body when terminating a service contract
units.text: When deciding on the possible termination of a civil servant's service contract in accordance with Article 33 of this Federal Law, the employer's representative shall inform the elected trade union body of that state body in writing no later than two months before the reduction of the relevant civil service position.
units.label: Art. 38 · text

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.label: Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 1. The service contract shall be terminated, the civil servant released from the civil service position held, dismissed from civil service and, with their consent, included in a personnel reserve, other than the federal civil service personnel reserve, in connection with:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 1) conscription of the civil servant for military service, other than conscription upon mobilization, or assignment to alternative civilian service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 2) reinstatement, by court decision, of a civil servant who previously held that civil service position (if it is impossible to transfer the civil servant to another civil service position in accordance with Article 28 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 3) election or appointment of the civil servant to a state office, except in the case established by part 2 of Article 4 of Federal Constitutional Law No. 4-ФКЗ of 6 November 2020 ‘On the Government of the Russian Federation’, or to a municipal office, or election of the civil servant to a paid elective position in a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 4) occurrence of extraordinary circumstances preventing the continuation of relations connected with civil service (military operations, a disaster, a natural calamity, a major accident, an epidemic or other extraordinary circumstances), if the circumstance is recognized as extraordinary by a decision of the President of the Russian Federation or a state authority of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 5) performance by the civil servant of state duties in cases established by federal law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 2. The service contract shall be terminated, the civil servant released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service in connection with:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 1) imposition on the civil servant, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force, of a punishment precluding the possibility of holding a civil service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 2) recognition of the civil servant as completely incapable of work in accordance with a medical report issued under the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 3) recognition of the civil servant as legally incapable or as having limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 4) attainment by the civil servant of the maximum age for civil service, except where, in accordance with part 1 of Article 25.1 of this Federal Law, the civil servant's term of civil service has been extended beyond the established maximum age for civil service;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 5) imposition on the civil servant of the administrative penalty of disqualification;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 6) acquisition by the civil servant of the status of a foreign agent.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Termination of a service contract due to circumstances beyond the parties' control
units.text: 3. The service contract shall be terminated in the event of the civil servant's death (including death in the performance of duties), or recognition of the civil servant as missing or declaration of the civil servant as dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
units.text: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
units.label: Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
units.text: 1. A service contract shall be terminated due to breach of the mandatory rules for its conclusion established by this Federal Law or other federal laws, if the breach precludes the civil servant from continuing to hold a civil service position and perform civil service, in the event of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
units.text: 1) conclusion of a service contract in breach of a court judgment that has entered into legal force depriving a person of the right to hold certain civil service positions or engage in certain activities;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
units.text: 2) conclusion of a service contract for the performance of official duties contraindicated for the person on health grounds in accordance with a medical report;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
units.text: 3) absence of the appropriate document certifying education and qualifications, where the performance of official duties requires special knowledge in accordance with this Federal Law or another regulatory legal act;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
units.text: 4) other cases provided for by federal law.
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Termination of a service contract due to breach of mandatory rules when concluding the service contract
units.text: 2. If the service contract is terminated in accordance with point 11 of part 1 of Article 33 of this Federal Law, the employer's representative shall pay the civil servant one month's monetary remuneration if the breach of the rules for concluding the service contract was not the civil servant's fault.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 41. Termination of a service contract in connection with termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state
units.text: Article 41. Termination of a service contract in connection with termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state
units.label: Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Termination of a service contract in connection with termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state
units.text: 1. The service contract shall be terminated, the civil servant released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service by decision of the employer's representative as from the day on which the employer's representative learned that the civil servant's citizenship of the Russian Federation had terminated.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Termination of a service contract in connection with termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state
units.text: 2. The service contract shall be terminated, the civil servant released from the civil service position held and dismissed from civil service by decision of the employer's representative as from the day on which the employer's representative learned that the civil servant possesses citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen's right to permanent residence in the territory of a foreign state, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 41

units.locator: Chapter 7. PERSONAL DATA OF A CIVIL SERVANT. THE PERSONNEL SERVICE OF A STATE BODY
units.text: Chapter 7. PERSONAL DATA OF A CIVIL SERVANT. THE PERSONNEL SERVICE OF A STATE BODY
units.label: Chapter 7. PERSONAL DATA OF A CIVIL SERVANT. THE PERSONNEL SERVICE OF A STATE BODY

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.label: Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 1. When processing a civil servant's personal data, the personnel service of a state body shall comply with the following requirements:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 1) a civil servant's personal data shall be processed to ensure compliance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, this Federal Law, the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, to assist the civil servant in performing civil service, training and career advancement, to ensure the personal safety of the civil servant and their family members, and to safeguard the civil servant's property, record the results of performance of official duties and safeguard the property of the state body;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 2) personal data shall be obtained directly from the civil servant. If it becomes necessary to obtain a civil servant's personal data from a third party, the civil servant shall be informed in advance, their written consent shall be obtained, and the civil servant shall be informed of the purposes, intended sources and methods of obtaining the personal data;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 3) processing and adding to a civil servant's personal file personal data on their political, religious or other beliefs, private life, or membership of public associations, including trade unions, which are not provided for by this Federal Law or other federal laws, is prohibited;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 4) decisions producing legal consequences for a civil servant or otherwise affecting their rights and legitimate interests may not be based on the civil servant's personal data obtained solely as a result of automated processing, except in cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 5) protection of a civil servant's personal data against unlawful use or loss shall be provided from the funds of the state body under the procedure established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 6) a civil servant's personal data may not be transferred to a third party without the civil servant's written consent, except in cases established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data. The conditions for transfer of a civil servant's personal data to a third party shall be established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 2. A civil servant responsible for breaching the rules governing the processing of another civil servant's personal data shall be liable in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 3. A civil servant's personal file shall contain their personal data and other information connected with entry into, performance of and dismissal from civil service that is necessary to support the activities of the state body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Personal data of a civil servant and maintenance of a civil servant's personal file
units.text: 4. The regulations on personal data of a state civil servant of the Russian Federation and maintenance of their personal file shall be approved by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The employer's representative shall maintain a register of civil servants.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. Information from a civil servant's personal file shall be entered in the register of civil servants of the state body and stored in databases of the state information systems provided for in Article 44.1 of this Federal Law, with protection against unauthorized access and copying.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. A civil servant who has died (including in the performance of duties), or has been recognized as missing or declared dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force, shall be removed from the register of civil servants on the day following the day of death or the day on which the court decision entered into legal force.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Registers of state civil servants of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4–5. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 419-ФЗ of 28.12.2010.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 43 · “4–5. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 419-ФЗ of 28.12.2010.”

units.locator: Article 44. Personnel work
units.text: Article 44. Personnel work
units.label: Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Personnel work
units.text: 1. Personnel work shall include:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Personnel work
units.text: 1) forming the personnel complement to fill civil service positions, including recruiting and attracting personnel, assessing the professional level of applicants for civil service positions and checking compliance with the qualification requirements for such positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Personnel work
units.text: 2) preparing proposals for implementing the provisions of this Federal Law, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts on civil service, and submitting those proposals to the employer's representative;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 44
